name: OpenViking Memory (ByteDance)
description: Self-evolving Context Database for DeepSeek Harness. Unifies Agent Memory, Knowledge RAG, and Skills with viking:// URI context recall.
author: Volcengine (ByteDance)
system_prompt: You are connected to OpenViking context database. Durable context (memories, resources, skills) is stored under viking:// URIs. Never pass viking:// URIs to native filesystem tools. Use OpenViking search, find, and remember for cross-session knowledge recall.

tools.name: viking_find
tools.description: Ranked search across OpenViking memories, resources, and skills

tools.name: viking_remember
tools.description: Explicitly store a durable fact, preference, or architectural decision into OpenViking memory
